description: Source code for rendering test result view in a React application, including components for displaying test errors, steps, image diffs, attachments, and worker test execution details.

classes.name: ImageDiffWithAnchors
classes.description: Extends ImageDiff with an array of anchor strings for linking purposes.

classes.name: StepTreeItem
classes.description: React component for rendering a test step and its nested sub-steps, including status icon, title, location, attachments, and duration.

methods.name: groupImageDiffs
methods.description: Groups image attachments into diffs with expected, actual, previous, and diff images, associating anchors for UI navigation.

methods.name: pickDiffForError
methods.description: Selects an image diff related to an error message if the error pertains to screenshot matching.

methods.name: buildWorkerLists
methods.description: Builds a map of worker indices to their associated test cases and execution order based on the report data.
